articles.title: American Detained in Cuba Quietly Released
articles.description: “An American held for nearly a decade in Cuba was quietly released earlier this year,” CNN reports. “Alina López Miyares’s release, which has not been previously reported, came amid soaring tensions between Washington and Havana, as the Trump administration has ratcheted up its pressure campaign to try to force changes to the government there.”

articles.title: American Detained in Cuba for Nearly a Decade Released, CNN Reports
articles.description: An American detained in Cuba since 2017 after being accused of espionage has been released, CNN reported on Friday, citing two sources familiar with the matter and a State Department spokesperson.
